fit: one full-scene fit per mode; thresholds use eligible=all_indices[indices%4096!=0], q[eligible-1]; start masses full marginal; alpha1 exact old frequencies
quantile: linear, eight bins, duplicate thresholds retained, searchsorted right

stream_contract.stream_order: channel0 then channel1, each ascending slots
stream_contract.context_reset: start PMF every4096; no entropy-stream reset
stream_contract.envelope_order: container channel-major overrides legacy descriptive code_order only

regression: one fitting replay on two development scenes before new fitting
e2e: each mode reads frozen uint8 file, fits its required models once, actually compresses required XZ sections, range encodes, assembles and writes; no cached XZ time substituted
pure_benchmark: one warmup and3 measured repeats, prepared transmitted models fixed; hashes checked outside timed section; no strict reencode in pure benchmark
stop: exactly4 reserve scenes then close; all failures retained; no fallback or candidate selection
